The application, PostgreSQL database, Redis service, and required external services are available.
Verify that the authentication function validates an active account using the submitted phone and password, issues an access token and refresh token, and stores the refresh-token state correctly.
The application, PostgreSQL database, Redis service, and required external services are available.
Update customer profile and verify insurance

Verify that the profile function updates the authenticated customer's information, stores the changes in PostgreSQL, calls the insurance service with the supplied insurance code, and returns the consolidated profile data.
The application, PostgreSQL database, Redis service, and required external services are available.
Create appointment and check in patient
Verify that the appointment function validates the customer profile, medical service, doctor schedule, and appointment slot before creating the appointment and customer visit used for check-in.
The application, PostgreSQL database, Redis service, and required external services are available.
Pay invoice and create queue ticket
Verify that the payment function records a successful invoice transaction, updates the invoice payment status, and creates exactly one queue ticket for the paid clinical service.
The application, PostgreSQL database, Redis service, and required external services are available.
Call queue ticket and start examination
Verify that the examination-start function calls the correct queue ticket, updates the customer visit, stores the patient's vital signs, and opens the related medical record for the assigned doctor.
The application, PostgreSQL database, Redis service, and required external services are available.
Verify that the examination function saves the diagnosis in the medical record, validates the selected ICD-10 code and medicines, and creates a prescription linked to the correct patient visit.
The application, PostgreSQL database, Redis service, and required external services are available.

Verify that the clinical-test ordering function validates the active medical record and selected laboratory services, creates the test request items, and places the patient in the appropriate laboratory queue.
The application, PostgreSQL database, Redis service, and required external services are available.
Record laboratory result and return patient to queue
Verify that the laboratory-result function stores the result for the correct test request, marks the request as completed, updates the patient journey, and returns the patient to the doctor's queue.
The application, PostgreSQL database, Redis service, and required external services are available.
Complete examination and create follow-up appointment
Verify that the examination-completion function finalizes the medical record, customer visit, and queue ticket and creates a follow-up appointment when the doctor specifies a follow-up date.
The application, PostgreSQL database, Redis service, and required external services are available.
Calculate insurance coverage and record payment
Verify that the insurance-payment function retrieves valid coverage information, calculates the insurer and patient portions, updates the invoice, and records the corresponding payment transaction.
The application, PostgreSQL database, Redis service, and required external services are available.
Create staff schedule and record attendance
Verify that the staff-scheduling function validates staff capability and availability, creates a non-conflicting work schedule, and records attendance against the correct schedule entry.
The application, PostgreSQL database, Redis service, and required external services are available.
Maintain department and medical service catalog
Verify that the catalog-management function creates or updates departments and medical services, preserves their active status and prices, and links each service to the correct staff capability.
The application, PostgreSQL database, Redis service, and required external services are available.
Send notification and manage support chat
Verify that the communication function creates notifications for the intended account, opens or reuses the correct support chat session, stores messages, and updates their delivery and read status.
The application, PostgreSQL database, Redis service, and required external services are available.
Retrieve patient journey and generate report
Verify that the reporting function aggregates the customer's visit, queue, medical-record, test, invoice, and feedback data and returns a consistent patient journey and dashboard report.
The application, PostgreSQL database, Redis service, and required external services are available.
